preprocessing: RGB PIL BILINEAR224; ImageNet normalization; metadata-matched

legacy_accepted_vest_positive_only.policy: Only accepted vest positives scored; no_vest predictions are not no-hi-vis evidence. Annotated proposal crops1.3 are oracle geometry, not whole detector pipeline; candidate uses person context1.05.

limitations: Prepared development splits, assistant labels; not expert certification or camera-disjoint blind factory benchmark.
No original factory TEST is in training or this prepared held-out test; factory support exists in validation only.
Crop-level static classifier comparison, not temporal full-pipeline event or tracker evaluation.
Thresholds were kept exactly as exported; test cannot be used to lower thresholds.
False-positive contact sheet inspected without relabelling or retuning held-out examples; labels remain development references, not expert-certified ground truth.

paired_same_source_crops.warning: Same source people but model-specific geometry: candidate full person1.05, legacy oracle annotated vest proposal1.3. Not detector pipeline performance.

deployment_scope: Automatic person compliance/clear in current production state machine
deployment_reasons: ordinary and unobservable are deliberately disabled at thresholds1.01; candidate cannot replace the three-way policy verifier.
Fixed calibrated threshold falsely accepts2/22 ordinary and3/13 unobservable held-out test references as compliant; geometry minimum does not remove all such errors.
Factory validation has16/18 true hi_vis accepted and0/9 false-compliant, but no factory test support and shared inspected cameras/actors; not independent factory generalisation.
Installing signal-clothing.onnx would replace the existing torso classifier. Its accepted positives directly vote worn/clear in the temporal gate; there is no separate hint-only channel.
Preserve existing legacy positive-only evidence and broad-policy rejection of legacy no_vest negatives. Do not lower exported thresholds using test.

training_audit.calibration_rule: argmax only; score grid .8..995(40); >=10 accepted; empirical precision>=.98 ordinary, >=.95 hi_vis/unobservable. Pick most accepted; ties prefer higher threshold. No choices ->1.01.
training_audit.calibration_limitation: Empirical selection gate on reused validation; no independent calibration split or precision confidence-bound guarantee. Softmax is not a calibrated physical safety probability.
training_audit.cause_assessment: The disabled classes failed the precision/support rule. Small diverse ordinary/unobservable development support and transfer/domain shift are plausible contributors; balancing does not add independent observations. No causal ablation run.
